svg.metadata:
{"diagram_source":"workflow.d2","management_instructions":"Read this article and the canonical `workflow.d2` source. At intake, read the current [arran4/projects](https://github.com/arran4/projects) record and, when a conversation link is supplied, maintain a minimal handoff pointer. Never copy detailed issue/PR information into Projects or assume an old handoff is current. For bug work, specify regression and visible scenario evidence and verify the diagnosis with the human after the PR when needed. Treat each node ID as a **checkpoint, not a mandatory sequential checklist**. First inspect the target repository, PRs/issues and the latest conversation context. Report the current node, concrete evidence, unresolved decisions, and the permitted next node(s). If the work is already at review, do not restart planning without reason. If a major design conflict appears, do not force a superficial patch: return to clarification and reconcile the issues.

At each checkpoint: identify the workstream, inspect actual GitHub state, find the current actor and action, distinguish automatic routing from human approval, perform authorised work, verify tool results, then record the transition and any blocker. A Chat LLM without GitHub capabilities must say so and prepare an actionable prompt or human step instead of pretending it updated a PR. Conversely, when it *can* maintain an issue, PR description or merge-readiness state, it should not bounce routine administration to the coding worker.

Use these compact status fields when resuming a conversation:

| Field | Expected content |
| --- | --- |
| Workstream | Repository, objective, conversation context and milestone |
| Current node | One of the IDs linked below, plus actual GitHub refs |
| Specification | Canonical issues, PRs and accepted decisions |
| PR tree | Parent/child/sibling relationships, blockers and mergeable leaves |
| Verification | Tests, current head, CI classification and gaps |
| Next action | Exact action, responsible actor, and any human approval required |
| Exit | Completed, deferred with trigger, or abandoned |","node_count":80,"node_description_selector":"g[data-workflow-node] > desc","schema":"agent-workflow-node-guidance/v2","source":"index.md"}

g.desc:
WS01 — Open one workstream Actor: Chat LLM. State: Keep related work in a single chat. Carry objective, linked GitHub state and next action; multiple independent chats may run.
Enter from: ST01 Initial release (repo/initial); ST02 Planned change (planned change); ST04 Maintenance (maintenance / audit); ST03 Bug or defect (enter workstream); ST05 Existing work (enter workstream); ST06 Release request (enter workstream).
Move to: WS06 Read Projects handoff when read handoff.

text.tspan: KEEP RELATED WORK IN A SINGLE CHAT.

g.title: Chat LLM: Carry objective, linked GitHub state and next action; multiple independent chats may run

g.desc:
WS02 — Inspect current baseline Actor: Chat LLM. State: Check the code and outstanding work. Check current repository state, existing specifications and outstanding dependencies.
Enter from: WS05 Save conversation link (inspect repository).
Move to: WS04 Choose the starting route? when classify entry.

text.tspan: CHECK THE CODE AND OUTSTANDING WORK.

g.title: Chat LLM: Check current repository state, existing specifications and outstanding dependencies

g.desc:
WS03 — Select discovery depth? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Choose how much planning is needed. Choose proportionate analysis; do not demand a full roadmap for a trivial fix.
Enter from: WS04 Choose the starting route? (planned change).
Move to: PL01 State detailed intent when major / initial / unclear; SP01 Reconcile GitHub issues when minor / clear / routine; BG01 Capture reproduction when bug discovered.

text.tspan: CHOOSE HOW MUCH PLANNING IS NEEDED.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Choose proportionate analysis; do not demand a full roadmap for a trivial fix

g.desc:
WS04 — Choose the starting route? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Route this request to the right process. Route the entry as new work, bug, resumed PR or release-only.
Enter from: WS02 Inspect current baseline (classify entry).
Move to: WS03 Select discovery depth? when planned change; BG01 Capture reproduction when reported bug; RV01 Inspect actual PR state when resume PR; RL01 Recommend release intent when release-only.

text.tspan: ROUTE THIS REQUEST TO THE RIGHT PROCESS.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Route the entry as new work, bug, resumed PR or release-only

g.desc:
WS05 — Save conversation link Actor: Chat LLM. State: Record a resumption pointer in Projects. If given a conversation link, add it to the owning arran4/projects file alongside the relevant issue/PR; do not replicate active work details.
Enter from: WS06 Read Projects handoff (register supplied conversation link).
Move to: WS02 Inspect current baseline when inspect repository.

text.tspan: RECORD A RESUMPTION POINTER IN PROJECTS.

g.title: Chat LLM: If given a conversation link, add it to the owning arran4/projects file alongside the relevant issue/PR; do not replicate active work details

g.desc:
WS06 — Read Projects handoff Actor: Chat LLM. State: Check related conversations and blockers. Read current arran4/projects, matching repo handoff and overlapping updates; use it as a between-chat index not as a live issue tracker.
Enter from: WS01 Open one workstream (read handoff).
Move to: WS05 Save conversation link when register supplied conversation link.
g.title: Chat LLM: Read current arran4/projects, matching repo handoff and overlapping updates; use it as a between-chat index not as a live issue tracker

g.desc:
BG01 — Capture reproduction Actor: Human. State: Show how the bug happens. Share observed and expected behaviour, stack traces, device or UI observations.
Enter from: WS03 Select discovery depth? (bug discovered); BG05 Cause confirmed? (not reproduced); WS04 Choose the starting route? (reported bug); RV14 Observed behavior correct? (diagnosis wrong).
Move to: BG02 How to debug? when evidence.
g.title: Human: Share observed and expected behaviour, stack traces, device or UI observations

g.desc:
BG02 — How to debug? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Choose who should investigate it. Select human interactive, Chat LLM research or Coding LLM investigation.
Enter from: BG01 Capture reproduction (evidence).
Move to: BG06 Prepare human diagnosis when human diagnosis; BG04 Chat diagnoses bug when Chat diagnosis; BG07 Prepare coding-agent diagnosis when coding-agent diagnosis.
g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Select human interactive, Chat LLM research or Coding LLM investigation

g.desc:
BG03 — Interactive diagnosis Actor: Human. State: Reproduce and inspect the issue together. Especially for Flutter: reproduce with the human, copy evidence and results back to chat.
Enter from: EX01 Who implements? (human UI debugging); BG06 Prepare human diagnosis (instructions provided).
Move to: BG05 Cause confirmed? when copy findings.

text.tspan: REPRODUCE AND INSPECT THE ISSUE TOGETHER.

g.title: Human: Especially for Flutter: reproduce with the human, copy evidence and results back to chat

g.desc:
BG04 — Chat diagnoses bug Actor: Chat LLM. State: Inspect code and explain the evidence. Investigate code or ask for focused coding-agent debugging when needed.
Enter from: BG02 How to debug? (Chat diagnosis).
Move to: BG05 Cause confirmed? when analysis.

text.tspan: INSPECT CODE AND EXPLAIN THE EVIDENCE.

g.title: Chat LLM: Investigate code or ask for focused coding-agent debugging when needed

g.desc:
BG05 — Cause confirmed? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Decide whether the diagnosis fits. Compare candidate cause to observed failure and decide if more diagnosis is required.
Enter from: BG03 Interactive diagnosis (copy findings); BG04 Chat diagnoses bug (analysis); BG08 Coding-agent investigation (agent evidence).
Move to: BG01 Capture reproduction when not reproduced; PL01 State detailed intent when needs redesign; BG09 Specify regression coverage when confirmed.
g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Compare candidate cause to observed failure and decide if more diagnosis is required

g.desc:
BG06 — Prepare human diagnosis Actor: Chat LLM. State: Explain steps and request specific evidence. Explain the suspected cause, why human testing helps, step-by-step checks, expected observations, process and explicit questions.
Enter from: BG02 How to debug? (human diagnosis).
Move to: BG03 Interactive diagnosis when instructions provided.

text.tspan: EXPLAIN STEPS AND REQUEST SPECIFIC EVIDENCE.

g.title: Chat LLM: Explain the suspected cause, why human testing helps, step-by-step checks, expected observations, process and explicit questions

g.desc:
BG07 — Prepare coding-agent diagnosis Actor: Chat LLM. State: Write a focused investigation prompt. Give the human a coding-agent prompt with reproduction, context, tests and expected diagnostic evidence.
Enter from: BG02 How to debug? (coding-agent diagnosis).
Move to: BG08 Coding-agent investigation when diagnostic prompt.
g.title: Chat LLM: Give the human a coding-agent prompt with reproduction, context, tests and expected diagnostic evidence

g.desc:
BG08 — Coding-agent investigation Actor: Coding LLM. State: Investigate with repository tools and tests. Reproduce the issue, gather test or log evidence and report findings without assuming the original hypothesis was correct.
Enter from: BG07 Prepare coding-agent diagnosis (diagnostic prompt).
Move to: BG05 Cause confirmed? when agent evidence.

text.tspan: INVESTIGATE WITH REPOSITORY TOOLS AND TESTS.

g.title: Coding LLM: Reproduce the issue, gather test or log evidence and report findings without assuming the original hypothesis was correct

g.desc:
BG09 — Specify regression coverage Actor: Chat LLM. State: Plan a test for the original failure. Specify a regression test and appropriate TXTAR/txtar or broad scenario evidence that demonstrates the behaviour.
Enter from: BG05 Cause confirmed? (confirmed).
Move to: SP01 Reconcile GitHub issues when regression test planned.

text.tspan: PLAN A TEST FOR THE ORIGINAL FAILURE.

g.title: Chat LLM: Specify a regression test and appropriate TXTAR/txtar or broad scenario evidence that demonstrates the behaviour

g.desc:
PL01 — State detailed intent Actor: Human. State: Explain the goal, constraints and examples. Describe what, why, constraints, examples and desired approach; answer and ask questions.
Enter from: WS03 Select discovery depth? (major / initial / unclear); BG05 Cause confirmed? (needs redesign); PL05 Enough specified? (not enough); RV04 What needs changing? (requirements conflict); RL09 Public exposure safe? (unsafe exposure).
Move to: PL02 Ask clarifying questions when draft intent.

text.tspan: EXPLAIN THE GOAL, CONSTRAINTS AND EXAMPLES.

g.title: Human: Describe what, why, constraints, examples and desired approach; answer and ask questions

g.desc:
PL02 — Ask clarifying questions Actor: Chat LLM. State: Ask what is missing or unclear. Ask targeted questions; revise scope after every material change.
Enter from: PL01 State detailed intent (draft intent); PL07 Contradictions resolved? (more questions).
Move to: PL03 Contradictions found? when questions answered.

text.tspan: ASK WHAT IS MISSING OR UNCLEAR.

g.title: Chat LLM: Ask targeted questions; revise scope after every material change

g.desc:
PL03 — Contradictions found? Actor: Chat LLM. State: Check for incompatible requirements. Challenge incompatible requirements, tests or architecture; revisit earlier decisions.
Enter from: PL02 Ask clarifying questions (questions answered).
Move to: PL04 Resolve ambiguities when contradictions found; PL05 Enough specified? when no contradictions.
g.title: Chat LLM: Challenge incompatible requirements, tests or architecture; revisit earlier decisions

g.desc:
PL04 — Resolve ambiguities Actor: Human. State: Agree on answers or defer open questions. Discuss alternatives, settle contradictions, or defer non-blocking questions explicitly.
Enter from: PL03 Contradictions found? (contradictions found).
Move to: PL07 Contradictions resolved? when answers recorded.

text.tspan: AGREE ON ANSWERS OR DEFER OPEN QUESTIONS.

g.title: Human: Discuss alternatives, settle contradictions, or defer non-blocking questions explicitly

g.desc:
PL05 — Enough specified? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Decide whether there is enough to start. Advance when sufficient, not necessarily complete; otherwise loop or park.
Enter from: PL03 Contradictions found? (no contradictions); PL07 Contradictions resolved? (resolved or deferred).
Move to: PL01 State detailed intent when not enough; CL05 Park Projects handoff when defer; CL06 Retire Projects handoff when abandon; SP01 Reconcile GitHub issues when sufficient.

text.tspan: DECIDE WHETHER THERE IS ENOUGH TO START.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Advance when sufficient, not necessarily complete; otherwise loop or park

g.desc:
SP01 — Reconcile GitHub issues Actor: Chat LLM. State: Match the work to existing GitHub issues. Search existing issues and PRs; align expected outcomes and acceptance cases.
Enter from: WS03 Select discovery depth? (minor / clear / routine); PL05 Enough specified? (sufficient); RV04 What needs changing? (issue/spec mismatch); BG09 Specify regression coverage (regression test planned).
Move to: SP02 Issue record adequate? when reconcile.

text.tspan: MATCH THE WORK TO EXISTING GITHUB ISSUES.

g.title: Chat LLM: Search existing issues and PRs; align expected outcomes and acceptance cases

g.desc:
SP02 — Issue record adequate? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Check whether an issue covers the work. Check missing tests, issue ownership, resolving scope and change implications.
Enter from: SP01 Reconcile GitHub issues (reconcile).
Move to: SP03 Request issue approval when new issue / major reframe; SP04 Persist accepted spec when existing issues valid.

text.tspan: CHECK WHETHER AN ISSUE COVERS THE WORK.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Check missing tests, issue ownership, resolving scope and change implications

g.desc:
SP03 — Request issue approval Actor: Human. State: Get approval for new or rewritten issues. Approve new issue creation or significant scope changes; maintain existing records when authorised.
Enter from: SP02 Issue record adequate? (new issue / major reframe).
Move to: SP05 Issue approval received? when approval requested.

text.tspan: GET APPROVAL FOR NEW OR REWRITTEN ISSUES.

g.title: Human: Approve new issue creation or significant scope changes; maintain existing records when authorised

g.desc:
SP04 — Persist accepted spec Actor: Chat LLM. State: Record agreed requirements in GitHub. Record decisions, open questions, criteria and dependencies in GitHub and linked conversation.
Enter from: SP02 Issue record adequate? (existing issues valid); SP05 Issue approval received? (approved).
Move to: SP06 Repository already exists? when spec saved.
g.title: Chat LLM: Record decisions, open questions, criteria and dependencies in GitHub and linked conversation

g.desc:
PL07 — Contradictions resolved? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Decide whether more questions are needed. Confirm conflicts were resolved, deferred or need another round of clarification.
Enter from: PL04 Resolve ambiguities (answers recorded).
Move to: PL02 Ask clarifying questions when more questions; PL05 Enough specified? when resolved or deferred.

text.tspan: DECIDE WHETHER MORE QUESTIONS ARE NEEDED.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Confirm conflicts were resolved, deferred or need another round of clarification

g.desc:
SP05 — Issue approval received? Actor: Human. State: Check whether the changed scope is approved. Approve an entirely new issue or significant change of specification, or hold it until clarified.
Enter from: SP03 Request issue approval (approval requested).
Move to: SP04 Persist accepted spec when approved; CL05 Park Projects handoff when not approved.

text.tspan: CHECK WHETHER THE CHANGED SCOPE IS APPROVED.

g.title: Human: Approve an entirely new issue or significant change of specification, or hold it until clarified

g.desc:
SP06 — Repository already exists? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Choose existing source or bootstrap. After accepted requirements are recorded, choose an existing repository or approved new repo bootstrap.
Enter from: SP04 Persist accepted spec (spec saved).
Move to: TR01 Work size and dependency? when existing repository; TR05 Bootstrap repository when new approved repo.
g.title: Human or Chat LLM: After accepted requirements are recorded, choose an existing repository or approved new repo bootstrap

g.desc:
TR01 — Work size and dependency? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Decide whether one PR is enough. Choose scope from dependencies and likely conflicts, not arbitrary linear stacking.
Enter from: TR05 Bootstrap repository (repository ready); SP06 Repository already exists? (existing repository).
Move to: TR02 Plan PR dependency tree when complex / dependent; EX01 Who implements? when single PR.

text.tspan: DECIDE WHETHER ONE PR IS ENOUGH.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Choose scope from dependencies and likely conflicts, not arbitrary linear stacking

g.desc:
TR02 — Plan PR dependency tree Actor: Chat LLM. State: Map PR dependencies and merge order. Map sibling PRs that can merge independently and dependent children that must wait.
Enter from: TR01 Work size and dependency? (complex / dependent).
Move to: TR03 Select runnable node when tree dependencies.

text.tspan: MAP PR DEPENDENCIES AND MERGE ORDER.

g.title: Chat LLM: Map sibling PRs that can merge independently and dependent children that must wait

g.desc:
TR03 — Select runnable node Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Pick work that is ready and unblocked. Choose a ready node; if one branch blocks, advance an independent sibling.
Enter from: TR02 Plan PR dependency tree (tree dependencies); RV10 More work in PR tree? (next sibling / child); TR07 Dogfood milestone needed? (more work first).
Move to: TR06 Runnable branch available? when check dependency status.

text.tspan: PICK WORK THAT IS READY AND UNBLOCKED.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Choose a ready node; if one branch blocks, advance an independent sibling

g.desc:
TR05 — Bootstrap repository Actor: Chat LLM. State: Set up the repo, tests and documentation. After human scope approval, initialise the repository, essential CI, documentation and licence, delegating source setup to the coding model as needed.
Enter from: SP06 Repository already exists? (new approved repo).
Move to: TR01 Work size and dependency? when repository ready.

text.tspan: SET UP THE REPO, TESTS AND DOCUMENTATION.

g.title: Chat LLM: After human scope approval, initialise the repository, essential CI, documentation and licence, delegating source setup to the coding model as needed

g.desc:
TR04 — Dogfood checkpoint Actor: Human. State: Test a useful intermediate milestone. Confirm which portion of the tree is sufficient to test or merge now.
Enter from: TR07 Dogfood milestone needed? (dogfood required).
Move to: RV01 Inspect actual PR state when test milestone.
g.title: Human: Confirm which portion of the tree is sufficient to test or merge now

g.desc:
TR06 — Runnable branch available? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Choose ready work, defer or cancel. Check PR dependencies to find an unblocked node or preserve a blocker/cancellation.
Enter from: TR03 Select runnable node (check dependency status).
Move to: EX01 Who implements? when unblocked node; CL05 Park Projects handoff when all blocked; CL06 Retire Projects handoff when cancel.

text.tspan: CHOOSE READY WORK, DEFER OR CANCEL.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Check PR dependencies to find an unblocked node or preserve a blocker/cancellation

g.desc:
TR07 — Dogfood milestone needed? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Decide whether to test the milestone. After a PR-tree checkpoint, decide if a runnable milestone needs human testing before closeout.
Enter from: RV10 More work in PR tree? (milestone reached).
Move to: TR04 Dogfood checkpoint when dogfood required; CL01 Audit issues and PRs when no more testing; TR03 Select runnable node when more work first.

text.tspan: DECIDE WHETHER TO TEST THE MILESTONE.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: After a PR-tree checkpoint, decide if a runnable milestone needs human testing before closeout

g.desc:
EX01 — Who implements? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Choose between a direct fix and an agent. For small changes try direct Chat LLM fix when able; otherwise write a prompt for Codex/Agy.
Enter from: TR01 Work size and dependency? (single PR); TR06 Runnable branch available? (unblocked node).
Move to: EX05 Chat direct fix when tiny + chat capable; EX02 Prepare implementation when coding model; BG03 Interactive diagnosis when human UI debugging.

text.tspan: CHOOSE BETWEEN A DIRECT FIX AND AN AGENT.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: For small changes try direct Chat LLM fix when able; otherwise write a prompt for Codex/Agy

g.desc:
EX02 — Prepare implementation Actor: Chat LLM. State: Write an actionable implementation prompt. Specify accepted issue state, exact branch, constraints, tests, dependency tree and expected PRs.
Enter from: EX01 Who implements? (coding model); RV06 Complex correction (corrective prompt).
Move to: EX03 Code and test locally when prompt approved.
g.title: Chat LLM: Specify accepted issue state, exact branch, constraints, tests, dependency tree and expected PRs

g.desc:
EX03 — Code and test locally Actor: Coding LLM. State: Build the change and run real tests. Use agent in interactive or YOLO container; iterate on code, tests and generator output.
Enter from: EX02 Prepare implementation (prompt approved).
Move to: EX04 Publish PR tree when tests and code.

text.tspan: BUILD THE CHANGE AND RUN REAL TESTS.

g.title: Coding LLM (Codex/Agy): Use agent in interactive or YOLO container; iterate on code, tests and generator output

g.desc:
EX04 — Publish PR tree Actor: Coding LLM. State: Push code and open linked pull requests. Push real commits and create the promised PRs, with explicit dependent bases and linked issues.
Enter from: EX03 Code and test locally (tests and code).
Move to: RV01 Inspect actual PR state when published.

text.tspan: PUSH CODE AND OPEN LINKED PULL REQUESTS.

g.title: Coding LLM (Codex/Agy): Push real commits and create the promised PRs, with explicit dependent bases and linked issues

g.desc:
EX05 — Chat direct fix Actor: Chat LLM. State: Make and test a small change in chat. Use available tooling to edit and test an isolated authorised branch, publish an inspectable PR.
Enter from: EX01 Who implements? (tiny + chat capable).
Move to: RV01 Inspect actual PR state when published.

text.tspan: MAKE AND TEST A SMALL CHANGE IN CHAT.

g.title: Chat LLM: Use available tooling to edit and test an isolated authorised branch, publish an inspectable PR

g.desc:
RV01 — Inspect actual PR state Actor: Chat LLM. State: Inspect what the PR actually contains. Verify published commits, comments, PR metadata, dependencies and fresh tests.
Enter from: TR04 Dogfood checkpoint (test milestone); EX04 Publish PR tree (published); EX05 Chat direct fix (published); RV05 Small repair (republished); WS04 Choose the starting route? (resume PR).
Move to: RV02 Inspect CI evidence when current head.

text.tspan: INSPECT WHAT THE PR ACTUALLY CONTAINS.

g.title: Chat LLM: Verify published commits, comments, PR metadata, dependencies and fresh tests

g.desc:
RV02 — Inspect CI evidence Actor: Chat LLM. State: Read check results and missing evidence. Required checks cannot be marked passed if absent; rerun or use accepted alternatives.
Enter from: RV01 Inspect actual PR state (current head).
Move to: RV17 Required CI available? when check required CI.

text.tspan: READ CHECK RESULTS AND MISSING EVIDENCE.

g.title: Chat LLM: Required checks cannot be marked passed if absent; rerun or use accepted alternatives

g.desc:
RV03 — Review correctness? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Compare the PR with requirements and tests. Check behaviour, issue match, closing keywords, test quality, conflicts and merge ordering.
Enter from: QA01 Check test evidence (tests assessed).
Move to: RV04 What needs changing? when findings.

text.tspan: COMPARE THE PR WITH REQUIREMENTS AND TESTS.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Check behaviour, issue match, closing keywords, test quality, conflicts and merge ordering

g.desc:
RV04 — What needs changing? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Choose the right correction or review path. Route repair to smallest appropriate stage, including back to Q&A and issue specifications.
Enter from: RV03 Review correctness? (findings); RV08 Merge approved? (changes requested); RV12 Extra verification needed? (human objections).
Move to: RV05 Small repair when simple conflict/fix; RV06 Complex correction when complex repair; PL01 State detailed intent when requirements conflict; SP01 Reconcile GitHub issues when issue/spec mismatch; RV07 Human PR review when ready; CL06 Retire Projects handoff when work no longer wanted.

text.tspan: CHOOSE THE RIGHT CORRECTION OR REVIEW PATH.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Route repair to smallest appropriate stage, including back to Q&A and issue specifications

g.desc:
RV05 — Small repair Actor: Human. State: Fix a straightforward issue or conflict. Resolve trivial conflict or tiny fix; Chat may patch when authorised, then republish and review.
Enter from: RV04 What needs changing? (simple conflict/fix).
Move to: RV01 Inspect actual PR state when republished.

text.tspan: FIX A STRAIGHTFORWARD ISSUE OR CONFLICT.

g.title: Human: Resolve trivial conflict or tiny fix; Chat may patch when authorised, then republish and review

g.desc:
RV06 — Complex correction Actor: Chat LLM. State: Send a focused request to a coding agent. Produce targeted prompt for Codex/Agy; repair existing branch/PR when safe.
Enter from: RV04 What needs changing? (complex repair); RV14 Observed behavior correct? (patch faulty).
Move to: EX02 Prepare implementation when corrective prompt.

text.tspan: SEND A FOCUSED REQUEST TO A CODING AGENT.

g.title: Chat LLM: Produce targeted prompt for Codex/Agy; repair existing branch/PR when safe

g.desc:
RV07 — Human PR review Actor: Human. State: Read and test the proposed changes. Read changes, test where appropriate, request redesign, defer, or approve.
Enter from: RV04 What needs changing? (ready).
Move to: RV12 Extra verification needed? when review feedback.

text.tspan: READ AND TEST THE PROPOSED CHANGES.

g.title: Human: Read changes, test where appropriate, request redesign, defer, or approve

g.desc:
RV08 — Merge approved? Actor: Human. State: Decide whether this PR may be merged. Explicit approval; passing CI or model readiness is not merge authority.
Enter from: RV12 Extra verification needed? (normal PR accepted); RV14 Observed behavior correct? (verified).
Move to: RV04 What needs changing? when changes requested; CL05 Park Projects handoff when hold; CL06 Retire Projects handoff when cancel work; RV09 Merge eligible node when approved.

text.tspan: DECIDE WHETHER THIS PR MAY BE MERGED.

g.title: Human: Explicit approval; passing CI or model readiness is not merge authority

g.desc:
RV09 — Merge eligible node Actor: GitHub / CI. State: Merge a reviewed, eligible pull request. Merge only valid, approved PR with required checks and dependency prerequisites satisfied.
Enter from: RV08 Merge approved? (approved).
Move to: RV10 More work in PR tree? when merged.

text.tspan: MERGE A REVIEWED, ELIGIBLE PULL REQUEST.

g.title: GitHub / CI: Merge only valid, approved PR with required checks and dependency prerequisites satisfied

g.desc:
RV10 — More work in PR tree? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Continue another PR or close the milestone. Update bases and conflicts; choose another ready sibling or pause dependent branch.
Enter from: RV09 Merge eligible node (merged).
Move to: TR03 Select runnable node when next sibling / child; CL05 Park Projects handoff when remaining work blocked; TR07 Dogfood milestone needed? when milestone reached.

text.tspan: RV10 · MORE WORK IN PR TREE?
CONTINUE ANOTHER PR OR CLOSE THE MILESTONE.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Update bases and conflicts; choose another ready sibling or pause dependent branch

g.desc:
RV12 — Extra verification needed? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Choose normal review or more evidence. After PR review, route bug/UI evidence to verification, objections to repair, otherwise human merge decision.
Enter from: RV07 Human PR review (review feedback).
Move to: RV04 What needs changing? when human objections; RV15 Who verifies the UI? when bug or UI proof; RV08 Merge approved? when normal PR accepted.

text.tspan: CHOOSE NORMAL REVIEW OR MORE EVIDENCE.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: After PR review, route bug/UI evidence to verification, objections to repair, otherwise human merge decision

g.desc:
RV13 — Human verifies behavior Actor: Human. State: Provide build and practical test steps. Run application or build locally, check the proposed bug diagnosis or UI change and return precise observations.
Enter from: RV15 Who verifies the UI? (human interactive).
Move to: RV14 Observed behavior correct? when human findings.

text.tspan: PROVIDE BUILD AND PRACTICAL TEST STEPS.

g.title: Human: Run application or build locally, check the proposed bug diagnosis or UI change and return precise observations

g.desc:
RV14 — Observed behavior correct? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Accept evidence or reinvestigate failures. Check visual/manual/automated evidence and route a wrong diagnosis to bug intake or a faulty patch to repair.
Enter from: RV13 Human verifies behavior (human findings); RV16 Automate visual proof (automated captures).
Move to: RV08 Merge approved? when verified; BG01 Capture reproduction when diagnosis wrong; RV06 Complex correction when patch faulty.
g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Check visual/manual/automated evidence and route a wrong diagnosis to bug intake or a faulty patch to repair

g.desc:
RV15 — Who verifies the UI? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Choose automated proof or human testing. Use Playwright or a reliable UI harness where suitable, otherwise human interactive device/local testing.
Enter from: RV12 Extra verification needed? (bug or UI proof).
Move to: RV13 Human verifies behavior when human interactive; RV16 Automate visual proof when Playwright or UI harness.

text.tspan: CHOOSE AUTOMATED PROOF OR HUMAN TESTING.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Use Playwright or a reliable UI harness where suitable, otherwise human interactive device/local testing

g.desc:
RV16 — Automate visual proof Actor: Coding LLM. State: Attach UI captures or scenario results. Coding LLM or Chat tooling: Produce Playwright UI tests, golden captures or scenario previews in PR/chat for verification.
Enter from: RV15 Who verifies the UI? (Playwright or UI harness).
Move to: RV14 Observed behavior correct? when automated captures.

text.tspan: ATTACH UI CAPTURES OR SCENARIO RESULTS.

g.title: Coding LLM or Chat tooling: Produce Playwright UI tests, golden captures or scenario previews in PR/chat for verification

g.desc:
RV17 — Required CI available? Actor: Chat LLM. State: Check whether required checks are satisfied. Evaluate required checks, pending, failure and private quota; do not claim missing CI has passed.
Enter from: RV02 Inspect CI evidence (check required CI).
Move to: QA01 Check test evidence when checks acceptable; CL05 Park Projects handoff when required checks blocked.

text.tspan: CHECK WHETHER REQUIRED CHECKS ARE SATISFIED.

g.title: Chat LLM: Evaluate required checks, pending, failure and private quota; do not claim missing CI has passed

g.desc:
QA01 — Check test evidence Actor: Chat LLM. State: Review unit, regression and broad scenarios. Assess updated regression tests, integration coverage, TXTAR/txtar CLI or API examples and visible end-to-end evidence in PR.
Enter from: RV17 Required CI available? (checks acceptable).
Move to: RV03 Review correctness? when tests assessed.

text.tspan: REVIEW UNIT, REGRESSION AND BROAD SCENARIOS.

g.title: Chat LLM: Assess updated regression tests, integration coverage, TXTAR/txtar CLI or API examples and visible end-to-end evidence in PR

g.desc:
CL01 — Audit issues and PRs Actor: Chat LLM. State: Confirm that the right issues are resolved. Check Fixes/Closes references, issue statuses, acceptance evidence, final implementation notes.
Enter from: TR07 Dogfood milestone needed? (no more testing).
Move to: CL02 Notify dependencies when issues correct.

text.tspan: CONFIRM THAT THE RIGHT ISSUES ARE RESOLVED.

g.title: Chat LLM: Check Fixes/Closes references, issue statuses, acceptance evidence, final implementation notes

g.desc:
CL02 — Notify dependencies Actor: Chat LLM. State: Update anything that depends on this work. Check version constraints, dependent PRs, projects and actionable update notices.
Enter from: CL01 Audit issues and PRs (issues correct).
Move to: CL03 Refresh Projects handoff when notify.

text.tspan: UPDATE ANYTHING THAT DEPENDS ON THIS WORK.

g.title: Chat LLM: Check version constraints, dependent PRs, projects and actionable update notices

g.desc:
CL03 — Refresh Projects handoff Actor: Chat LLM. State: Keep only current links and next steps. Update arran4/projects with roadmap, workstream and current milestone.
Enter from: CL02 Notify dependencies (notify).
Move to: CL04 Update PR repository when tracker current.

text.tspan: KEEP ONLY CURRENT LINKS AND NEXT STEPS.

g.title: Chat LLM: Update arran4/projects with roadmap, workstream and current milestone

g.desc:
CL04 — Update PR repository Actor: Chat LLM. State: Record announcement tasks and readiness. Update arran4/public-relations with accurate materials or future campaign tasks.
Enter from: CL03 Refresh Projects handoff (tracker current).
Move to: RL01 Recommend release intent when evaluate version.
g.title: Chat LLM: Update arran4/public-relations with accurate materials or future campaign tasks

g.desc:
CL05 — Park Projects handoff Actor: Chat LLM. State: Save the blocker and resumption link. When pausing, update arran4/projects with current chat link, blocker, next action and relevant issue/PR, not duplicate task details.
Enter from: PL05 Enough specified? (defer); RV08 Merge approved? (hold); RV10 More work in PR tree? (remaining work blocked); RL02 Publish now? (defer release); RL05 History rewrite needed? (rewrite consent pending); RL08 Release verified? (publishing failed); SP05 Issue approval received? (not approved); TR06 Runnable branch available? (all blocked); RV17 Required CI available? (required checks blocked).
Move to: EN02 Deferred / blocked when handoff parked.

text.tspan: SAVE THE BLOCKER AND RESUMPTION LINK.

g.title: Chat LLM: When pausing, update arran4/projects with current chat link, blocker, next action and relevant issue/PR, not duplicate task details

g.desc:
CL06 — Retire Projects handoff Actor: Chat LLM. State: Keep useful links, mark work stopped. When abandoning, preserve a concise reason and link, without pretending source issues or PRs were completed.
Enter from: PL05 Enough specified? (abandon); RV04 What needs changing? (work no longer wanted); RV08 Merge approved? (cancel work); TR06 Runnable branch available? (cancel).
Move to: EN03 Abandoned when closure recorded.

text.tspan: KEEP USEFUL LINKS, MARK WORK STOPPED.

g.title: Chat LLM: When abandoning, preserve a concise reason and link, without pretending source issues or PRs were completed

g.desc:
RL01 — Recommend release intent Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Choose whether and how to release this work. Use accepted scope, roadmap, merged changes and release guidance; patch may be routine if authorised.
Enter from: CL04 Update PR repository (evaluate version); WS04 Choose the starting route? (release-only).
Move to: RL02 Publish now? when release recommendation.

text.tspan: CHOOSE WHETHER AND HOW TO RELEASE THIS WORK.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Use accepted scope, roadmap, merged changes and release guidance; patch may be routine if authorised

g.desc:
RL02 — Publish now? Actor: Human. State: Decide whether it is time to publish. May choose no release, normal versioned release, or delayed/public opening.
Enter from: RL01 Recommend release intent (release recommendation).
Move to: EN01 Completed when no release / done; CL05 Park Projects handoff when defer release; RL03 First public opening? when release approved.

text.tspan: DECIDE WHETHER IT IS TIME TO PUBLISH.

g.title: Human: May choose no release, normal versioned release, or delayed/public opening

g.desc:
RL03 — First public opening? Actor: Human. State: Check whether the repo must become public. If private-to-public, require broader quality, provenance, licence, copyright and link checks.
Enter from: RL02 Publish now? (release approved).
Move to: RL07 Run release workflow when already public / private release; RL04 Audit public exposure when first public opening.

text.tspan: CHECK WHETHER THE REPO MUST BECOME PUBLIC.

g.title: Human: If private-to-public, require broader quality, provenance, licence, copyright and link checks

g.desc:
RL04 — Audit public exposure Actor: Chat LLM. State: Inspect secrets, licences and history. Inspect repository history, links, copyright, documentation, quality and release assets.
Enter from: RL03 First public opening? (first public opening).
Move to: RL09 Public exposure safe? when audit completed.
g.title: Chat LLM: Inspect repository history, links, copyright, documentation, quality and release assets

g.desc:
RL05 — History rewrite needed? Actor: Human. State: Ask before rewriting published Git history. Force-push or rewrite only on explicit informed approval; consider collaborators and tags.
Enter from: RL09 Public exposure safe? (safe to proceed).
Move to: RL06 Approve visibility change when no rewrite / approved rewrite; CL05 Park Projects handoff when rewrite consent pending.

text.tspan: ASK BEFORE REWRITING PUBLISHED GIT HISTORY.

g.title: Human: Force-push or rewrite only on explicit informed approval; consider collaborators and tags

g.desc:
RL06 — Approve visibility change Actor: Human. State: Approve making the repository public. Make public only after verified audit and approval.
Enter from: RL05 History rewrite needed? (no rewrite / approved rewrite).
Move to: RL07 Run release workflow when public approved.
g.title: Human: Make public only after verified audit and approval

g.desc:
RL07 — Run release workflow Actor: GitHub / CI. State: Run the approved tagging and release action. Use documented release-safe action to tag and publish; no duplicate release publisher.
Enter from: RL03 First public opening? (already public / private release); RL06 Approve visibility change (public approved); RL08 Release verified? (retry release).
Move to: RL08 Release verified? when workflow complete.

text.tspan: RUN THE APPROVED TAGGING AND RELEASE ACTION.

g.title: GitHub / CI: Use documented release-safe action to tag and publish; no duplicate release publisher

g.desc:
RL08 — Release verified? Actor: Chat LLM. State: Check tags, assets and distribution. Confirm actual tag, release, packages and downstream impact; update tracker and announcements.
Enter from: RL07 Run release workflow (workflow complete).
Move to: EN01 Completed when confirmed; CL05 Park Projects handoff when publishing failed; RL07 Run release workflow when retry release.
g.title: Chat LLM: Confirm actual tag, release, packages and downstream impact; update tracker and announcements

g.desc:
RL09 — Public exposure safe? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Decide if audit findings block publication. Review secrets, licensing, ownership and history audit results; substantial unresolved exposure returns to specification.
Enter from: RL04 Audit public exposure (audit completed).
Move to: RL05 History rewrite needed? when safe to proceed; PL01 State detailed intent when unsafe exposure.

text.tspan: DECIDE IF AUDIT FINDINGS BLOCK PUBLICATION.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Review secrets, licensing, ownership and history audit results; substantial unresolved exposure returns to specification

g.desc:
EN01 — Completed Actor: GitHub / CI. State: The agreed milestone is finished. Work and any authorised release completed; issue and tracker state reconciled.
Enter from: RL02 Publish now? (no release / done); RL08 Release verified? (confirmed).
Move to: Terminal node; no further workflow transition.
g.title: GitHub / CI: Work and any authorised release completed; issue and tracker state reconciled

g.desc:
EN02 — Deferred / blocked Actor: GitHub / CI. State: Record what is blocked and when to resume. Record what remains, owner, dependency, and the condition for resuming.
Enter from: CL05 Park Projects handoff (handoff parked).
Move to: Terminal node; no further workflow transition.

text.tspan: RECORD WHAT IS BLOCKED AND WHEN TO RESUME.

g.title: GitHub / CI: Record what remains, owner, dependency, and the condition for resuming

g.desc:
EN03 — Abandoned Actor: Human. State: Stop the work and record why. Document cancellation, superseded PRs, issue closure/retention and change of direction.
Enter from: CL06 Retire Projects handoff (closure recorded).
Move to: Terminal node; no further workflow transition.

text.tspan: STOP THE WORK AND RECORD WHY.

g.title: Human: Document cancellation, superseded PRs, issue closure/retention and change of direction

g.desc:
ST01 — Initial release Actor: Human. State: Start a new project or first release. A new project or first public version.
Enter from: Pick this circle in the framed START HERE group.
Move to: WS01 Open one workstream when repo/initial.

text.tspan: START A NEW PROJECT OR FIRST RELEASE.

g.title: Human: A new project or first public version

g.desc:
ST02 — Planned change Actor: Human. State: Ask for a feature or improvement. A feature or change of any size; classify scope later.
Enter from: Pick this circle in the framed START HERE group.
Move to: WS01 Open one workstream when planned change.

text.tspan: ASK FOR A FEATURE OR IMPROVEMENT.

g.title: Human: A feature or change of any size; classify scope later

g.desc:
ST03 — Bug or defect Actor: Human. State: Describe what is not working. An observed failure, including interactive Flutter problems.
Enter from: Pick this circle in the framed START HERE group.
Move to: WS01 Open one workstream when enter workstream.
g.title: Human: An observed failure, including interactive Flutter problems

g.desc:
ST04 — Maintenance Actor: Human. State: Keep dependencies and tooling current. Manual or automated upkeep; also may be folded into another workstream.
Enter from: Pick this circle in the framed START HERE group.
Move to: WS01 Open one workstream when maintenance / audit.
g.title: Human: Manual or automated upkeep; also may be folded into another workstream

g.desc:
ST05 — Existing work Actor: Human. State: Resume an issue, PR or stalled task. Resume an existing issue, PR tree or review checkpoint.
Enter from: Pick this circle in the framed START HERE group.
Move to: WS01 Open one workstream when enter workstream.

text.tspan: RESUME AN ISSUE, PR OR STALLED TASK.

g.title: Human: Resume an existing issue, PR tree or review checkpoint

g.desc:
ST06 — Release request Actor: Human. State: Publish work that is already merged. Release-only entry that does not require new code.
Enter from: Pick this circle in the framed START HERE group.
Move to: WS01 Open one workstream when enter workstream.

text.tspan: PUBLISH WORK THAT IS ALREADY MERGED.

g.title: Human: Release-only entry that does not require new code
Chat LLM: Carry objective, linked GitHub state and next action; multiple independent chats may run
Chat LLM: Check current repository state, existing specifications and outstanding dependencies
Human or Chat LLM: Choose proportionate analysis; do not demand a full roadmap for a trivial fix
Human or Chat LLM: Route the entry as new work, bug, resumed PR or release-only
Chat LLM: If given a conversation link, add it to the owning arran4/projects file alongside the relevant issue/PR; do not replicate active work details
Chat LLM: Read current arran4/projects, matching repo handoff and overlapping updates; use it as a between-chat index not as a live issue tracker
Human: Share observed and expected behaviour, stack traces, device or UI observations
Human or Chat LLM: Select human interactive, Chat LLM research or Coding LLM investigation
Human: Especially for Flutter: reproduce with the human, copy evidence and results back to chat
Chat LLM: Investigate code or ask for focused coding-agent debugging when needed
Human or Chat LLM: Compare candidate cause to observed failure and decide if more diagnosis is required
Chat LLM: Explain the suspected cause, why human testing helps, step-by-step checks, expected observations, process and explicit questions
Chat LLM: Give the human a coding-agent prompt with reproduction, context, tests and expected diagnostic evidence
Coding LLM: Reproduce the issue, gather test or log evidence and report findings without assuming the original hypothesis was correct
Chat LLM: Specify a regression test and appropriate TXTAR/txtar or broad scenario evidence that demonstrates the behaviour
Human: Describe what, why, constraints, examples and desired approach; answer and ask questions
Chat LLM: Ask targeted questions; revise scope after every material change
Chat LLM: Challenge incompatible requirements, tests or architecture; revisit earlier decisions
Human: Discuss alternatives, settle contradictions, or defer non-blocking questions explicitly
Human or Chat LLM: Advance when sufficient, not necessarily complete; otherwise loop or park
Chat LLM: Search existing issues and PRs; align expected outcomes and acceptance cases
Human or Chat LLM: Check missing tests, issue ownership, resolving scope and change implications
Human: Approve new issue creation or significant scope changes; maintain existing records when authorised
Chat LLM: Record decisions, open questions, criteria and dependencies in GitHub and linked conversation
Human or Chat LLM: Confirm conflicts were resolved, deferred or need another round of clarification
Human: Approve an entirely new issue or significant change of specification, or hold it until clarified
Human or Chat LLM: After accepted requirements are recorded, choose an existing repository or approved new repo bootstrap
Human or Chat LLM: Choose scope from dependencies and likely conflicts, not arbitrary linear stacking
Chat LLM: Map sibling PRs that can merge independently and dependent children that must wait
Human or Chat LLM: Choose a ready node; if one branch blocks, advance an independent sibling
Chat LLM: After human scope approval, initialise the repository, essential CI, documentation and licence, delegating source setup to the coding model as needed
Human: Confirm which portion of the tree is sufficient to test or merge now
Human or Chat LLM: Check PR dependencies to find an unblocked node or preserve a blocker/cancellation
Human or Chat LLM: After a PR-tree checkpoint, decide if a runnable milestone needs human testing before closeout
Human or Chat LLM: For small changes try direct Chat LLM fix when able; otherwise write a prompt for Codex/Agy
Chat LLM: Specify accepted issue state, exact branch, constraints, tests, dependency tree and expected PRs
Coding LLM (Codex/Agy): Use agent in interactive or YOLO container; iterate on code, tests and generator output
Coding LLM (Codex/Agy): Push real commits and create the promised PRs, with explicit dependent bases and linked issues
Chat LLM: Use available tooling to edit and test an isolated authorised branch, publish an inspectable PR
Chat LLM: Verify published commits, comments, PR metadata, dependencies and fresh tests
Chat LLM: Required checks cannot be marked passed if absent; rerun or use accepted alternatives
Human or Chat LLM: Check behaviour, issue match, closing keywords, test quality, conflicts and merge ordering
Human or Chat LLM: Route repair to smallest appropriate stage, including back to Q&A and issue specifications
Human: Resolve trivial conflict or tiny fix; Chat may patch when authorised, then republish and review
Chat LLM: Produce targeted prompt for Codex/Agy; repair existing branch/PR when safe
Human: Read changes, test where appropriate, request redesign, defer, or approve
Human: Explicit approval; passing CI or model readiness is not merge authority
GitHub / CI: Merge only valid, approved PR with required checks and dependency prerequisites satisfied
Human or Chat LLM: Update bases and conflicts; choose another ready sibling or pause dependent branch
Human or Chat LLM: After PR review, route bug/UI evidence to verification, objections to repair, otherwise human merge decision
Human: Run application or build locally, check the proposed bug diagnosis or UI change and return precise observations
Human or Chat LLM: Check visual/manual/automated evidence and route a wrong diagnosis to bug intake or a faulty patch to repair
Human or Chat LLM: Use Playwright or a reliable UI harness where suitable, otherwise human interactive device/local testing
Coding LLM or Chat tooling: Produce Playwright UI tests, golden captures or scenario previews in PR/chat for verification
Chat LLM: Evaluate required checks, pending, failure and private quota; do not claim missing CI has passed
Chat LLM: Assess updated regression tests, integration coverage, TXTAR/txtar CLI or API examples and visible end-to-end evidence in PR
Chat LLM: Check Fixes/Closes references, issue statuses, acceptance evidence, final implementation notes
Chat LLM: Check version constraints, dependent PRs, projects and actionable update notices
Chat LLM: Update arran4/projects with roadmap, workstream and current milestone
Chat LLM: Update arran4/public-relations with accurate materials or future campaign tasks
Chat LLM: When pausing, update arran4/projects with current chat link, blocker, next action and relevant issue/PR, not duplicate task details
Chat LLM: When abandoning, preserve a concise reason and link, without pretending source issues or PRs were completed
Human or Chat LLM: Use accepted scope, roadmap, merged changes and release guidance; patch may be routine if authorised
Human: May choose no release, normal versioned release, or delayed/public opening
Human: If private-to-public, require broader quality, provenance, licence, copyright and link checks
Chat LLM: Inspect repository history, links, copyright, documentation, quality and release assets
Human: Force-push or rewrite only on explicit informed approval; consider collaborators and tags
Human: Make public only after verified audit and approval
GitHub / CI: Use documented release-safe action to tag and publish; no duplicate release publisher
Chat LLM: Confirm actual tag, release, packages and downstream impact; update tracker and announcements
Human or Chat LLM: Review secrets, licensing, ownership and history audit results; substantial unresolved exposure returns to specification
GitHub / CI: Work and any authorised release completed; issue and tracker state reconciled
GitHub / CI: Record what remains, owner, dependency, and the condition for resuming
Human: Document cancellation, superseded PRs, issue closure/retention and change of direction
Human: A new project or first public version
Human: A feature or change of any size; classify scope later
Human: An observed failure, including interactive Flutter problems
Human: Manual or automated upkeep; also may be folded into another workstream
Human: Resume an existing issue, PR tree or review checkpoint
